content:
Maya: FYI customer 'Acme Digital' (acct_id: acct_8f3) hit a billing issue after a mid-cycle downgrade. Invoice inv_2026-03-07 shows a full-month credit instead of prorated, and PO handling + card fallback seems to have conflicted. Ticket #TICK-4412 created.
Joel (Finance): Can you paste the invoice + events? need to confirm timestamps relative to billing cycle.
Maya: Pasting minimal event log from billing webhook for visibility:
```
2026-03-07T02:11:08Z payment_attempt: card_declined code=card_declined txn=txn_aa12
2026-03-07T02:12:35Z customer_uploaded_po: po_332 accepted_by finance
2026-03-07T02:13:00Z subscription:update downgrade plan=p100 -> p50 effective_immediately true
2026-03-07T02:13:03Z credit_note: created credit_id=cn_777 amount=10000 cents description=mid-cycle adjustment
2026-03-07T02:13:05Z invoice: updated lines: removed p100, added p50
```
Maya: The user expects a prorated credit of ~$40.00 (they were on p100 $100/mo to p50 $50/mo with 15 days remaining). Invoice shows credit $100.00.
Rekha: Did the PO acceptance step trigger any manual apply flow? our PO path sometimes creates a full-cycle credit pending manual reconciliation.
Joel (Finance): Checking ledger: credit_id cn_777 applied to inv_2026-03-07 for full $100.00. Source in system says "auto_credit_on_downgrade": true. That flag should be prorated but looks like a legacy fallback.
Billing Bot: Automated rule match: "downgrade-credit-policy: legacy_full_credit" matched because payment method status = fallback_po during event window.
Kevin (Eng): That rule was intentionally introduced in 2024 for PO-first customers to avoid shorting them on mid-cycle churn when card had already failed. But we changed logic for immediate_effect downgrades; maybe a gap with simultaneous PO acceptance.
Samir: Repro steps I used in staging to try and hit same flow:
1) Create subscription on monthly plan p100 at 2026-03-01
2) Configure payment method to card that will decline (use test card 4000 0000 0000 0002)
3) Trigger subscription downgrade API: `POST /v1/subscriptions/sub_123/actions` payload `{ "plan": "p50", "proration_behavior": "none", "effective_at": "now" }`
4) Simulate PO upload event `POST /internal/events` `{ "type": "customer_uploaded_po", "po_id": "po_test", "acct": "acct_8f3" }`
Result: staging created credit cn_test for full amount ($100) and applied it to invoice.
Samir: Attaching the minimal API request/response we got in staging:
```
Request: POST /v1/subscriptions/sub_123/actions
Body: {"plan":"p50","proration_behavior":"none","effective_at":"now"}
Response 200 OK: {"id":"sub_123","status":"active","current_period_end":"2026-03-31"}
Internal event: customer_uploaded_po processed by handler v2.1 -> set payment_method_status = "po_pending"
Credit creation call: POST /internal/credits {"sub":"sub_123","amount_cents":10000,"reason":"downgrade_legacy_policy"} -> 201 cn_test
```
Rekha: That matches the customer case. So root cause: when payment_method_status transitions to PO/fallback within the same second/minute as downgrade and proration_behavior is `none`, the legacy rule fires and issues full-month credit.
Joel (Finance): Impact: how many customers? query shows ~12 accounts in last 30d with same pattern (card_decline -> po_upload -> downgrade immediate). Mostly EDU and larger accounts. Potential refund exposure ~ $1.8k.
Kevin (Eng): Proposed fix: change rule to compute pro-rated amount when `effective_immediately` is true and `subscription.proration_behavior` != "none" OR if `customer_uploaded_po` event occurs within 5 minutes, treat as payment method switch not as PO-legacy full-credit. I'll draft a PR.
Maya: Customer wants a manual correction ASAP. They need a $60 refund (expected). Can finance issue a manual credit note and adjust ledger?
Joel (Finance): Yes — will create manual credit cn_manual_4412 for $60 and apply to outstanding balance. Need approval from CS manager.
Rekha: @Maya please confirm the contact and permission from Acme to apply manual credit. I'll hold until confirmed.
Maya: Confirmed — Acme CS approved manual apply, contact sara@acme.com.
Billing Bot: Ticket #TICK-4412 updated: owner=Joel (Finance), severity=high, action=manual_credit_pending.
Samir: I'll open PR to change rule and add integration test that simulates simultaneous events. Link when ready.
Kevin (Eng): Also add a short-circuit to the credit creation path to call `calculate_proration(sub, effective_time)` and override amount if policy was legacy_full_credit.
Joel (Finance): I'll create a postmortem style note after fix with list of impacted invoices and manual entries.
Maya: Thanks all. Timeline: manual credit today, PR + staging test tomorrow, deploy next week.
Rekha: Adding follow-up checklist:
- [ ] Joel: manual credit applied
- [ ] Samir: PR + tests
- [ ] Kevin: code review + deploy
- [ ] Maya: confirm customer satisfied
- [ ] Finance: confirm ledger reconciliation
Maya: I'll update ticket and ping when customer confirms. :thumbsup:
